title: Simulator boot readiness through Gateway
description: Lease a free iOS simulator through the Gateway, verify resource.health observes it running, then release the lease and verify it stopped.

check-slot.intent: Require a free slot before taking control of its simulator.
check-slot.cmd: FARMSLOT_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:{{params.gateway_port}}/ws node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway fleet.status '{"forceRefresh":true}' | jq -ec 'select(.fleet.stale != true) | .fleet.slots[] | select(.slot == "{{params.slot_id}}" and .lifecycle == "ready" and .currentRunId == null and .agent == "idle") | {slot,lifecycle,currentRunId,agent}'

check-stopped.intent: Require the simulator to be stopped before this recipe takes ownership of its boot.
check-stopped.cmd: for attempt in 1 2; do FARMSLOT_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=15000 FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:{{params.gateway_port}}/ws node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway resource.health '{"slotId":"{{params.slot_id}}","resourceId":"ios-sim"}' | jq -ec '.resources[] | select(.id == "ios-sim" and .status == "stopped")' || exit 1; sleep 2; done

boot.intent: Acquire an exclusive Gateway simulator lease, verify health, and release the lease even when verification fails.

boot-succeeded.intent: Require the Gateway simulator lease to report success.

health.intent: Require an observed running simulator, not only a successful boot RPC.

shutdown.intent: Require the Gateway simulator lease release to report success.

stopped.intent: Require the simulator to be stopped before releasing the slot.

verify-inventory.intent: Confirm the simulator has settled in Shutdown, not a transient booting state.
verify-inventory.cmd: FARMSLOT_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=15000 FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:{{params.gateway_port}}/ws node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway resource.device.inventory '{"slotId":"{{params.slot_id}}","refresh":true}' | jq -ec --arg slot '{{params.slot_id}}' '.devices[] | select(.platform == "ios" and (.configuredForSlots | index($slot)) and .state == "Shutdown")'
